Author: @AmberS-V
Comment:
I once was at a museum, by myself, just wanting some quiet time.
I didnt join a tour.
But while in a gallary section, a young man a few years younger than myself walked up and very quickly and excitedly starting telling me all about the painiting we were in front of.
I honestly can't remember much about the paiting itself, other than that it was of a beautiful landscape with hills.
Even his facts are a blurred sound in my head/memory.
But how he was about the facts, and being able to share them with someone in that moment is what I remember.
In the next room, he continued on to another piece, as did I.
His mother and caregiver came up to me and thanked me for letting her son "nerd out" about one of his favorite paintings, explaining he is autistic and knows every bit of information about several of the pieces, but he rarely gets to talk to someone about them.
It was just such a beautiful moment, seeing how incredibly excited he was to share the things he knew about something seemingly as simple as a painting.
The way he lit up about it all...
I'll never forget that encounter ❤
